notes: Primary ask: dedicated capacity sizing workshop focused on throughput guarantees and latency SLO negotiations.
Workload mix: 70% chat (multi-turn), 20% embeddings for search, 10% reranking for ranking pipelines.
Observed telemetry (prelim): baseline steady QPS ~12 rps during business hours, average request 320 tokens (input+output), peak bursts to ~48 rps observed during campaign spikes.
Customer target SLOs: p95 latency <= 350ms for chat generation (single model path), p99 under 800ms acceptable with fallback; 99.95% availability SLA requested for dedicated infra.
Throughput requirements: need sustained token/sec estimate for steady-state ~3.8k tokens/sec, peak sustained bursts up to ~15k tokens/sec for ~10-15 min windows.
GPU sizing ask: customer wants guidance on reserved GPU count (H100 vs A100 equivalent), expected KV cache per GPU, batch sizing and expected multiplexing to meet p95 SLOs.
Security/compliance notes: must deploy in customer VPC, KMS integration required, retention controls for chat transcripts, SOC2 in procurement checklist.
Procurement timeline: indicated procurement sign-off earliest May 2026; procurement requires line-item SLA language and credits schedule.
Competitive context: evaluating Redwood Dedicated vs Google Vertex + custom autoscaled pods; cost sensitivity high for token-heavy reranking pipeline.
Requested deliverables from workshop: sizing workbook with baseline/capacity headroom, recommended batch and kv-cache configs, fallback model matrix and SLA proposal draft.
AE notes: 'We need a firm throughput guarantee for peak windows, with automatic routing to lower-cost model variants when capacity constrained.'
Open items: customer model quantization profile not shared yet (blocks exact GPU RAM calc); region preference is us-west-2 for low latency to their clients.
